target.location_description: outer continental shelf off Cochin/Kochi, Arabian Sea, approximately 65 km SW of Cochin in Pillay et al. 2016

morphology: explicitly described as simple crater-like morphology
ORANGE_BASIN_CRATER_POCKMARKS.structural_context: occur in a domain of polygonal faulting; the broader study images disrupted reflectors, faults, seismic chimneys and natural gas/fluid escape features
ORANGE_BASIN_CRATER_POCKMARKS.source: Marine Geophysical Research 2023, 3D reflection seismic imaging of natural gas/fluid escape features in the deep-water Orange Basin of South Africa
ORANGE_BASIN_CRATER_POCKMARKS.epistemic_effect_on_SR004: Strongly falsifies any argument that a ~600 m circular, steep-sided, tens-of-metres-deep depression is too large or too crater-like to be a pockmark. Morphology alone cannot establish impact.

SCANNER_POCKMARK_NORTH_SEA.geometry: approximately 900 x 450 m wide, 22 m deep, approximately 155 m water depth
diagnostics: seismic chimney beneath pockmark extending to about 1 km depth
gas-related bright reflectors near top of chimney
SCANNER_POCKMARK_NORTH_SEA.epistemic_effect_on_SR004: Near-match in water depth and horizontal scale provides a direct marine fluid-escape morphology control.

SOUTH_PASS_BLOCK_78_GAS_BLOWOUT_CRATER.geometry: approximately 600 m diameter and 30 m deep
SOUTH_PASS_BLOCK_78_GAS_BLOWOUT_CRATER.source: Cathles et al., Marine and Petroleum Geology, physics of gas chimney and pockmark formation
SOUTH_PASS_BLOCK_78_GAS_BLOWOUT_CRATER.epistemic_effect_on_SR004: Demonstrates that gas/fluid overpressure and sediment collapse can physically generate a depression on almost the same diameter/depth scale as SR-004. It is not evidence that SR-004 was anthropogenic.

diagnostics: diamictite and fining-upward gravity-flow/turbidite crater fill
shocked quartz identified across multiple core samples
marine clays and limestone in post-impact fill
HUMMELN_SWEDEN.epistemic_effect_on_SR004: Closest confirmed small shallow-marine impact control found so far. It shows that a real impact of broadly comparable scale should ultimately yield an impactite/shock record when the correct stratigraphic interval is sampled.

LOCKNE_SWEDEN.important_marine_crater_caveat: A preserved raised rim is not mandatory in a marine impact. At Lockne the rim wall may have collapsed and been eroded during resurge.
LOCKNE_SWEDEN.epistemic_effect_on_SR004: Absence of a conspicuous raised rim cannot by itself falsify impact in a shallow-marine target; impact diagnosis must instead lean on impactites, shock, excavation/damage architecture and resurge/ejecta facies.

diagnostics: shocked minerals adjacent to crater floor
SILVERPIT_NORTH_SEA.epistemic_effect_on_SR004: Demonstrates that preserved depth/diameter can become very small in a genuine buried/submarine impact. Therefore SR-004 d/D cannot be used as a decisive anti-impact test. Internal deformation architecture is more diagnostic.

updated_discriminant_assessment.reason: The known distributions overlap: natural crater-like pockmarks can be 700-900 m wide and ~114 m deep, while confirmed submarine impacts can preserve very shallow relief after modification and burial.
features_now_downgraded_as_non_diagnosti: lack of a conspicuous raised rim alone
highest_value_fluid_escape_discriminants: vertical chimney or pipe below center
highest_value_impact_discriminants: shocked quartz/feldspar or other diagnostic shock metamorphism

current_hypothesis_ranking.update: Strengthened by modern natural crater-pockmark analogs whose size, circularity and relief encompass or exceed SR-004.
Still viable because marine impacts can lose rims and exhibit low preserved d/D. However no diagnostic shock/impactite evidence has yet been published for SR-004.

next_killer_test.name: SR004_INTERNAL_ARCHITECTURE_AND_CORE_STRATIGRAPHY_GATE
required_data: full-resolution SBP or multichannel seismic crossing exact center
core coordinate and complete lithologic log for the 12.5 m central core
deeper penetration below crater-fill interval if available
next_killer_test.fluid_escape_pass: chimney/pipe + gas/acoustic signatures and/or seep geochemistry
next_killer_test.impact_pass: impactite/shock evidence and excavation/damage/resurge architecture without a feeder chimney
next_killer_test.ambiguous: circular bowl morphology or geophysical anomaly without subsurface diagnostic structure
